description: This file contains helper functions for encoding and decoding 3GPP RRC ASN.1 messages related to 5G NR, including setup, reconfiguration, resume, and security mode command messages.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_setup_msg
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 RRC setup message with cell config and radio bearers.

methods.name: get_transaction_id
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID from RRC setup complete or UL DCCH message.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_smc_msg
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 Security Mode Command message with security algorithms.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_reconfiguration_msg
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 RRC reconfiguration message with various configuration parameters.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_resume_msg
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 RRC resume message with configuration data.
